{
  "first_3_seconds": "A close-up of a trembling servant girl (Prudence) pleading with a noblewoman. The noblewoman suddenly whips around, thrusts the sharp tip of a riding crop directly into Prudence's face, and threatens her with 'Do you want the same punishment?' while baring her teeth in rage.",
  "ending": "Juliana, now revealed to be a disguised noblewoman playing a maid, stares defiantly down the hallway with soot on her face, declaring via voiceover that she will return as a healer and cannot be stopped.",
  "problems": [
    "The name switch from 'Prudence' to 'Juliana' is confusing; the viewer sees two different women but doesn't immediately realize they are the same character or that the second woman is the protagonist.",
    "The transition from the threat scene to the scrubbing scene lacks visual context for why the noblewoman is watching someone else scrub, creating a slight disconnect in the narrative flow.",
    "The reveal of the hidden book and vial happens quickly and might be missed by a scrolling viewer without prior knowledge."
  ],
  "hook_score": 9,
  "cliffhanger_score": 8,
  "standalone_score": 6,
  "verdict": "post",
  "pitch": "The clip opens with an immediate, visceral threat that hooks the viewer, then pivots to a compelling secret identity revenge plot that promises high-stakes drama."
}
